Company Policies

## Security Policy

All employees must follow these security guidelines:

1. Password Requirements
   - Minimum 12 characters
   - Must include uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters
   - Change password every 90 days
   - Never share passwords

2. Data Protection
   - Encrypt all sensitive company data
   - Use VPN for remote connections
   - Lock computer when away from desk
   - Report any security incidents immediately

3. Device Management
   - Company devices must have full disk encryption
   - Install all security updates within 7 days
   - Enable antivirus and firewall
   - Physical devices must not be left unattended

## Expense Policy

### Reimbursable Expenses

Employees can be reimbursed for:
- Business travel (flights, hotels, ground transportation)
- Client entertainment and meals ($75 per day limit)
- Conference and training expenses
- Office supplies for remote work

### Submission Process

1. Submit expense report within 30 days
2. Attach receipts for all expenses over $25
3. Include business purpose and date
4. Get manager approval
5. Finance will process within 5 business days

## Internet and Email Policy

### Email Usage

- Email is for business purposes only
- Professional communication standards apply
- Company monitors all email traffic
- Emails are company property

### Internet Usage

- No personal streaming or downloads
- No illegal content or websites
- Company monitors internet traffic
- Excessive personal use may result in disciplinary action

## Attendance and Punctuality

- Normal business hours are 9 AM to 5 PM
- Employees must arrive on time
- Use PTO for planned absences
- Notify manager of unexpected absences within 30 minutes

## Performance Reviews

- Annual performance reviews in December
- Mid-year check-ins in June
- Reviews based on job description and goals
- Results impact salary adjustments and promotions

Contact Management with any policy questions.
